maya: Quick intake — Raven-55B (open checkpoint). Requesting prioritization for a customer-facing assistant path. TL;DR: FP16 smoke looks OK, we need quant experiments + safety/eval gating.

omar: Sounds reasonable. What's the proposed priority score?

maya: Proposed score 68/100.
Reasons: product impact 25, infra risk 15, eval pass prob 14, cost delta -6, roadmap fit 20.

chris: Can you paste the perf numbers we have so far? latency / throughput / mem?

maya: Quick bench (noisy):
```
seq_len=80, batch=1 -> 115ms/token (A100), kv_mem=18GB
seq_len=80, batch=8 -> 42ms/token (A100)
```
These are baseline FP16 runs.

omar: We need a clear quant plan: target int8 and an automatic FP16 fallback. Who owns experiments?

maya: Janet will lead quant. @janet?

janet: I can take it. Plan: static 8-bit and dynamic 8-bit runs, measure instr-following, perplexity, and regression suites. Expect ~1.7x perf improvement, small drop in some instruction cases. ETA 5 business days.

maya: Also must run safety/hallucination checks against our customer prompt set. @eval-bot can you kick off the standard harness?

(eval-bot automated): queued: instruction-following, toxic-qa, factuality, consistency. Will upload CSV to #eng-ml/results when done.

chris: Roadmap check — Q2 release window opens week 3. If quant looks green and safety delta < 2% instr accuracy, we can schedule a two-week canary on Dedicated.

omar: Ops risk: memory pressure for 80-token contexts in the dedupe pipeline observed before. Add caching and OOM stress tests. Also confirm kernel support for 4-bit fallback if we need it.

maya: Gating checklist (short):
- quant experiments (owner: janet)
- safety & hallucination evals (eval-bot + customer prompts)
- perf bench on Dedicated + A/B config (chris)
- cost estimate delta (finance calc)
- canary rollout playbook + rollback (engbot)

engbot: created task ONB-2134 Raven-55B canary playbook. Assigned to chris.

janet: I started quant runs this morning; posting logs + diff reports to the intake doc.

chris: I'll run dedicated perf and gating infra next two days. Will post p95/p99 numbers and memory traces.

maya: If quant passes and eval delta < 2% we'll bump priority -> high and lock for mid-tier release. Sync on Tue 11am to decide.

chris: +1 to prioritize for mid-tier customers. :thumbsup:

omar: Also flagging potential cost-effectiveness: estimate ~20-30% token-cost reduction with int8 at parity for latency. Need finance confirmation.

maya: Thanks everyone. Quick action items: janet starts quant, eval-bot runs harness, chris does dedicated perf, engbot created playbook. We'll reconvene Tue.
